_note: Pattern indices map to the Teensy flat bank (runPattern() in main.cpp). 0–7 are the operator/button bank (shared with switches). 8–10 are the fire-ritual finale (dimAmbient/fireFull/idleAmbient). 11–14 are question-reaction patterns (wormYes/wormNo/scrunch/fold). 15 is the calibration bench tool. 16–19 are the painter question patterns (paintMonet/paintPicasso/paintDali/paintDaVinci). Optional yes.label / no.label override the default 'Yes' / 'No' button text. type:choice questions carry an options[] array of { id, label, msg, pattern }.
_disabled_note: Parked while the MAX4466 mic is unwired: the mic riddle is removed from the live pool. To re-enable, move the entry from _disabled_questions back into questions[]. The firmware reads ONLY questions[]; _disabled_questions is ignored. Data-only change — re-run `pio run -t uploadfs` to apply.
